summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel (Live Patch 40 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP4)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 5.14.21-150400.24.164 fixes one security issue

The following security issue was fixed:

- CVE-2026-43284: xfrm: esp: avoid in-place decrypt on shared skb frags (bsc#1264459).
